bio: Ann McGuire, known as Nancy, was born at Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, on 8 March 1928, a sister of Kathryn McGuire and, family records say, the twin of Elizabeth 'Betsy' McGuire, who shares her birth date. She married Robert Holland (1925-1979) and died at Scranton on 4 January 2007. She was John's great-aunt.
researchNotes: Ann "Nancy" McGuire, twin of Elizabeth "Betsy" (both b. 8 Mar 1928 per FS), married Robert Holland (1925-1979) and died at Scranton on 4 Jan 2007 ([R4-S1]; a GenealogyBank obituary index entry is attached; the image would not download in round 3).
